meta.title: INFLUX: the marketplace for brands and creators
meta.description: Brands: verified creators. Creators: campaigns that fit you. An INFLUX account manager approves every introduction and supports you all the way to an agreement.

hero.title: Brands and creators: <muted>from introduction to agreement, with an account manager by your side</muted>
hero.lead: Brands find verified creators, and creators find campaigns that fit them. An INFLUX account manager approves every introduction, joins the conversation and prepares the contract.
hero.reassurance: Free to sign up. INFLUX commission only on concluded collaborations.

problem.title: Between follow-ups and informal deals, <muted>collaborations stall</muted>
problem.lead: Unanswered messages, unclear rates, deals agreed in a few lines: without a shared framework, every collaboration starts from scratch.

painPoints.search: Hours spent spotting profiles, without knowing if their stats are reliable.
painPoints.followUp: Follow-ups scattered across emails, social networks and chat apps.
painPoints.contract: Deals agreed in a few lines, with no written contract and no one to bridge the gap.

problem.privacyNote: The brand, the creator and the INFLUX account manager talk in one place: your contact details are never shared.

method.title: From brief to publication, <muted>an INFLUX account manager at every step</muted>
method.lead: Every introduction is approved, then followed through to publication by a named INFLUX account manager. Everything happens on the platform and stays on record, protecting brands and creators alike.

brief.title: You publish your brief
brief.body: Product, goals, formats, budget, timing and target audience: you describe your campaign, and our team reviews it before it goes live. You can also browse verified profiles, shown anonymously.

introduction.title: INFLUX approves every introduction
introduction.body: Your contact request, a creator’s application or a suggestion from our team: an INFLUX account manager reviews every introduction within one business day and explains each decision.

acceptance.title: Both sides accept, then identities are revealed
acceptance.body: The brand and the creator each accept the introduction. Usernames and names are only shared once both have agreed; email addresses and phone numbers never are.

conversation.title: A three-way conversation
conversation.body: The brand, the creator and your named INFLUX account manager talk in a dedicated messaging space: deliverables, timing, usage rights, price. Messages are kept.

contract.title: A contract prepared by your account manager
contract.body: Once you agree, your account manager prepares the contract and sends it to you for signature. It states the amount, the included INFLUX commission, the deliverables and the payment terms.

delivery.title: Publication and follow-up
delivery.body: The creator publishes and the brand approves: your account manager follows the collaboration through to the end and remains your contact if anything goes wrong.

creatorNetwork.title: Our team presents your profile <muted>to brands in your space</muted>
creatorNetwork.lead: Complete your profile, get your stats verified and browse open campaigns. Your username is only shared with a brand once you accept the introduction.

useCases.title: Your goal <muted>shapes which creators we suggest</muted>
useCases.lead: Content for your channels, an offer to push, a product release or a lasting presence: state your goal in the brief, and our team uses it to pick profiles.

ugc.title: Content for your own channels
ugc.body: Photos and videos shot by creators, to post on your pages and ads. How long and where you may use them is set out in the contract.

acquisition.title: Promote an offer
acquisition.body: A discount code or limited-time offer shared by creators; you track sales with your own tools.
acquisition.formats: promo code in stories, short video, post

productLaunch.title: Release a new product
productLaunch.body: Introduce your product from day one to an audience already drawn to your category.

awareness.title: Become part of a community
awareness.body: Build a lasting presence with creators whose editorial style matches your brand.

howItWorks.title: Three steps to get started, <muted>whether you’re a brand or a creator</muted>
howItWorks.lead: Signing up is free and only asks for the essentials. The more complete your profile, the better our team can suggest relevant introductions.

createAccount.title: Create your free account
createAccount.advertiser: A few details are enough to open your company account.
createAccount.creator: A few details are enough, plus confirming you’re 18 or older.

completeProfile.title: Complete your profile
completeProfile.advertiser: Sector, products, goals, indicative budget: these help our team target its suggestions.
completeProfile.creator: Social accounts, topics, audience, formats and rates, then a check of your stats.

receiveProposals.title: Receive proposals
receiveProposals.advertiser: Our team suggests verified creators and explains each choice; you can also request a contact yourself.
receiveProposals.creator: Our team sends you relevant campaigns; you accept or decline.

pricing.title: Free to sign up, <muted>commission only on a concluded collaboration</muted>
pricing.lead: The INFLUX commission pays for a service: hand-picking creators, approving every introduction, support from an account manager and preparing the contract. It is included in the collaboration amount, never added on top, and nothing is owed to INFLUX without a concluded collaboration.

audience.advertiser: For brands: the collaboration amount is your total cost, INFLUX commission included.
audience.creator: For creators: before you commit, your INFLUX account manager tells you what you will receive, and the contract puts it in writing.

whyInflux.title: Built to see <muted>every collaboration through</muted>
whyInflux.lead: A team that selects, an account manager who supports you, one place to follow everything: this is what the INFLUX commission gets you.

qualifiedMatching.title: A selection made by our team
qualifiedMatching.body: Every suggestion is prepared by our team, based on your brief and on profiles with verified stats. You know why each creator is suggested to you.

dedicatedAgent.title: An account manager by your side
dedicatedAgent.body: A named INFLUX account manager joins every conversation, helps the brand and the creator agree on deliverables and price, then prepares the contract.

allInInflux.title: Everything stays in INFLUX
allInInflux.body: Search, conversations and follow-up of the collaboration all live in one place, without ever sharing your contact details. If there’s a disagreement, what was agreed is easy to find.

faq.title: What to know <muted>before you sign up</muted>
faq.lead: Money, countries, profiles, conversations: the essentials, for brands and creators alike.

signupCost.question: Does it cost anything to sign up for INFLUX?
signupCost.answer: No. Signing up is free for brands and creators alike, with no subscription. INFLUX only earns money through a commission on collaborations concluded through the platform: as long as no collaboration is concluded, you pay nothing to INFLUX.

commission.question: How much does INFLUX cost, and what does the creator get?
commission.answer: The INFLUX commission is included in the amount of each collaboration, which is the brand’s total cost: it is never added on top. Before you commit, your INFLUX account manager tells you its amount and what the creator receives, and the contract then puts it in writing.

payment.question: How does payment work?
payment.answer: Payment terms are set in the contract your INFLUX account manager prepares with you: amount, schedule and what the creator receives. INFLUX never asks for your bank details to use the platform.

currency.question: Which currency are collaborations in?
currency.answer: Each collaboration uses a single currency, agreed with your account manager and stated in the contract: the amount and the INFLUX commission are both expressed in that currency.

openCountries.question: Is INFLUX open in my country?
openCountries.answer: Yes. Sign-up and introductions are open worldwide, and the platform is available in French and English.

hiddenHandles.question: Why are creator profiles anonymous?
hiddenHandles.answer: So that choices rest on verified information and the collaboration is built on INFLUX. Before the introduction, the brand sees topics, audience, verified stats, portfolio and the “verified” badge. Usernames and social links are shared once the brand and the creator have both accepted the introduction. Email addresses and phone numbers are never shared, on either side.

messaging.question: Why does an INFLUX account manager join the conversation?
messaging.answer: Because that is what gets collaborations over the line. Every introduction opens a three-way conversation: the brand, the creator and a named INFLUX account manager, who helps you reach an agreement and then prepares the contract. They can also talk privately with each of you. Messages are kept and may be read by the INFLUX team to support you; every such reading is logged.

eligibility.question: Who can join as a creator, and how are profiles verified?
eligibility.answer: Any creator aged 18 or older, whether an individual or a professional, wherever they live. People under 18 are not accepted. Our team checks the stats provided and the ownership of each account, for example with a code added to the bio. Checked profiles get the “verified” badge. INFLUX makes no claim about follower authenticity.

reassurance.noPayment: No payment details required to sign up
